name: @fuyu/system-monitor
description: CPU, GPU, memory, network, battery and the busiest programs on the island, with 5-minute charts and a collapsed bar that turns yellow or red when readings run high.
author: TixXin

description.zh-CN: 在岛上看 CPU、GPU、内存、网速、电池和最占资源的程序，带 5 分钟曲线；收起条读数偏高变黄、过高变红。会运行系统自带的程序取数（Windows 上是 PowerShell，Mac 上是 vm_stat、ps 等），不联网。
description.en: CPU, GPU, memory, network, battery and the busiest programs on the island, with 5-minute charts; the collapsed bar turns yellow or red when readings run high. Runs built-in system programs to read them (PowerShell on Windows; vm_stat, ps and others on Mac), with no network access.
